QUOTE: Every struct member is declared as `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(foo)`, so by default the field is really named `private_foo`. Code that writes `ctx.foo` fails to compile because no such field exists.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes the two macro branches and which code opts out, but it never states that a consumer with the define sees plain names while an ordinary public-header consumer sees the renamed `private_` ones; it only says opted-out code gets plain names.
